xe674fb4565.title: اذان الفجر
xe674fb4565.description: يصدر المسجد أذانًا للصلاة للاجتماع وعبادة الله عز وجل من خلال الترانيم المقدسة والكتب الإسلامية.

tv285156.title: سدف
tv285156.description: تشرع امرأة في إجراء تحقيقها الخاص للكشف عن الحقيقة وراء انتحار أختها.
tv285156.description_en: Set in 1970s kuwait following a series of kidnappings, where the only trace left is a polaroid photograph of the victim left in the crime scene. A family drama following Fayez his wife Amani and their daughter Sarah, Fayez is a struggling actor, who is given a chance to become a star, as their lives seems to be on the right track their daughter is kidnapped. It becomes a game of cat and mouse, everyone becomes a suspect, even Fayez himself

x5c59e64e0d.title: الأخبار
x5c59e64e0d.description: برنامج اقتصادي يتضمن فقرات حول قضايا الطاقة، بما في ذلك النفط والغاز ومصادر الطاقة المتجددة.

x9e02e3450e.title: اذان الظهر
x9e02e3450e.description: يصدر زعيم ديني مسلم صلاة الظهر، وهو ترديد تراتيل من المفترض أن يتم أداؤها بعد منتصف النهار، أمام جماعة من أتباعه في مكة.

xca48d68185.title: متون
xca48d68185.description: هذا فيلم وثائقي، من فئة الأفلام الدينية

x206cc616c5.title: اذان العصر
x206cc616c5.description: يتلو الزعماء الدينيون المسلمون صلاة العصر، إحدى الصلوات الخمس اليومية في الإسلام، على الهواء مباشرة من مدينة مكة المكرمة.

tv156143.title: مغامرات ماركو بولو
tv156143.original_title: The Adventures of the Young Marco Polo
tv156143.description: عندما يُفقد والده، ينطلق ماركو بولو وأصدقاؤه في رحلةٍ للعثور عليه.

x09b4a971a2.title: اذان المغرب
x09b4a971a2.description: أحد رجال الدين يدعو المصلين إلى حضور صلاة العشاء في المسجد والتبرك من الله تعالى.

x9183113c1f.title: اذان العشاء
x9183113c1f.description: يؤذن المؤذن لصلاة العشاء ويقرأ آيات من القرآن الكريم قبل أن يجتمع المصلون للصلاة على الله تعالى وطلب بركاته.

tv256350.title: بدر
tv256350.description_en: The events of the series revolve around Sharkan's attempt to seize power with the help of his entourage and oppressive followers, after they were able to arrest Badr al-Zaman, put him in prison, and announced his death to the people.

tv215721.title: عودة الروح
tv215721.description_en: The Shadow of Çınar is the story of how the life of young Çınar (meaning plane) who used to have a happy life with her husband and three children turned upside down in a night… Under the Shadow of the Plane is the struggle of a young women whose family broke up with a slander and whose life was stolen for existing… The Shadow of Çınar is the story of those are hit for six by people whom they think are their friends, who are patient and far from complaining and become comrades with longing…

tv271444.title: أجمل الحكايات
tv271444.description_en: At an orphanage, the children are sad because they received broken toys as gifts. Professor Grampy sees the children while passing by in his sled and has an idea on how to give them a merry Christmas.

tv245984.title: من كثر حبي لك
tv245984.title_en: Because I Love You So Much
tv245984.description_en: Inside the halls of a residential building, the residents of the building meet, and friendly relationships, marriages, and divorces arise between them. On the other hand, family problems, murders, and thefts occur, so the residents seek to intensify their efforts to solve such things.

x09728c2201.title: غمض عينك
x09728c2201.description: يعود فارس إلى قريته، ويكشف أسرارًا وذكريات من الماضي الغامض.

mv634399.title: وجهة
mv634399.description_en: The story of the comedy is about a group of blind people who live in a place that is like hell and is not surrounded by any kind of care or appreciation for their difficult situation comes to them Arafa Shawaf (Mohammed Sobhi) blind who was in prison and came out to come and lead them and become their leader and tries to uncover the head of the body who does not He cares about them and does not give them their money.

tv102466.title: بروكار
tv102466.description_en: The show follows Damascene artisans in the 1940s as they fight to protect the secrets of the famed brokar textile amid French Mandate pressure, neighborhood rivalries, and personal conflicts. A heritage‑driven Syrian period drama blending craftsmanship, resistance, and traditional “shamī” atmosphere.
tv102466.description_fr: Les événements ont lieu en 1942 pendant la période de l'occupation française de la Syrie, où un ingénieur français tente de voler l'idée de fabriquer des sacs en brocart.

xa1dbea256e.title: سيُعلن لاحقًا
xa1dbea256e.description: لم يتم بعد تحديد البرامج المقررة لهذه الفترة الزمنية، وجاري العمل على تأكيدها.

tv301947.title: مدن وحضارات
tv301947.description_en: The series takes viewers on an extraordinary journey around the world, exploring the most magnificent landmarks in various cities and countries.

xbd4646669e.title: صلاة الجمعة
xbd4646669e.description: يجتمع المسلمون في جميع أنحاء العالم للدعاء لله تعالى وأداء صلاة الجمعة في مساجد مختلفة.
